title: Video by dontopenit.stories
description:
You’re watching TV on the 23rd floor… then the sirens start. 🚨
Your whole building rushed to the stairs. Nobody came out.
At 2:58 AM, the whole city’s dark… but the elevator dings. 

Would you get in? 👀
Follow for Part 2.
